eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

encodeParams(bytes,(string,address,strin.details: Encodes the action and security data into the payload bytes expected by `runMacro`.

params.params: ABI-encoded macro-specific parameters, opaque to the forwarder.
params.security: Security parameters (domain, macroContract, provider, validAfter, validBefore, nonce).

getDigest(address,bytes).details: Returns the EIP-712 digest of the payload. This is the value which should be signed off-chain.

returns._0: digest     EIP-712 digest of the payload.

getStructHash(address,bytes).details: Returns the EIP-712 struct hash of the payload.

returns._0: structHash   EIP-712 struct hash of the payload.

getTypeDefinition(address,bytes).details: Returns the full EIP-712 type definition string for the given macro and payload.

returns._0: typeDef    Full EIP-712 type definition string.

getTypeHash(address,bytes).details: Returns the keccak256 hash of the EIP-712 type definition.

returns._0: typeHash   keccak256 hash of the type definition.

runMacro(address,bytes,address,bytes).details: Runs the macro with an EIP-712 signed payload. Reverts if the signature is invalid or if the payload fails security checks.

params.signature: EIP-712 signature over the payload digest.
params.signer: Address which signed the payload and on whose behalf the macro runs.

returns._0: success    True if the macro execution succeeded.

SELF_PROVIDER().notice: Reserved provider value: when set, allows the signer to submit their own signed transaction.
